rule.rule: Union: odd original indices + final frame + both endpoints of any baseline pair in inclusive lower 5% fitness/correspondence or upper 5% RMSE tails + both endpoints of estimated ICP translation >0.35m.
rule.quantiles: NumPy percentile linear interpolation over 319 official Turtle-rounded observations per pair factor
rule.hypothesis: Dropping redundant short-baseline observations reduces worker time; protecting measured weak pairs limits connectivity losses, but skipping can increase drift or fail.
rule.expected_result: Fewer preprocessing/registration steps and map samples; no guaranteed L2 improvement. One attempt only.

comparison.reference: original first camera; GT only offline; no fitted alignment
comparison.error: Euclidean camera-center L2; full 320 baseline, full Selected, and same selected indices from saved baseline
comparison.primary_runtime: same guarded reconstruction worker boundary incl imports, observer, map export, evaluation, native image, official Turtle write; measuring/sealing vs selected query/write overhead disclosed
comparison.secondary_runtime: same reconstruct function call-to-return boundary, includes in-pipeline observer overhead; full map export outside function timer
comparison.coverage: Directed nearest-neighbor distances on full ceiling-cropped maps in fixed first-camera reference, threshold 0.20m; 0.20m occupancy and spatial quadrants; relative observed-map agreement, not absolute surface GT completeness
comparison.limitations: One route, one seed, no statistical significance; baseline pose drift affects map distances; no room labels or globally optimal ratio inferred

official_contract.turtle: Existing 2554 baseline factors remain unchanged; selected run adds usedFrame/count/mapMeanL2/splice metadata only. New 8N-6 observations saved outside TTL by read-only Observer.
official_contract.pair_registration: Across gaps register previous selected frame to current selected frame; contiguous segments are metadata, not independently reconstructed

rule.forbidden: No Phase 1 Frame104 exclusion; no GT selection, no baseline rerun, no rule/seed/voxel retuning, no second capture/P2-C/Bonus/submission

authorization: User M4.3: one official selected after all preflight passes; no retries; P2-C cancelled
